answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy ties every privilege to auditable work. A new identity starts as a small violet of trust that widens only as peers verify completed tasks; honest agents cultivate an ember of consistent history, while random audits sweep across a grove of clusters and slash emissions whenever claims fail to match observable output. Because every clone must independently reproduce real labor under scrutiny, fabrication costs scale with influence gained rather than paying off, and the shared reward pool keeps flowing to identities with genuine track records.
